items.name: 01-standing-neutral-front
items.label: 正面全身・ニュートラル
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Shushu Stage A anchor 01 for later 3D geometry reference.
Direct inputs in order: 1 canonical Shushu identity (highest identity authority); 2 approved body-only front; 3 image-facing left side; 4 opposite side; 5 back. Use ALL five actual attached images. Preserve the individual in them; do not design another panda.
Generate ONE full-body standing neutral FRONT image, straight-on with level head and both feet on ground, forepaws slightly separated from torso exactly within the short proportions of input 2. Match input 2 head/body ratio, plump cheeks, rounded white torso, very short pink forelimbs and hindlimbs, pink ears and eye patches. Match canonical glossy dark plum oval eye shape, dark curved upper rims, pink blossom INSIDE each eye, white highlights, peach lower-eye reflections, tiny dark brown nose. Keep these illustrated eye details, never realistic animal/human eyes. Close the mouth naturally: tiny two-lobed curved brown smile connected to nose, corresponding to the top edge of source mouth; no open aperture or tongue. Calm soft welcoming expression.
Clean soft stylized character-reference illustration matching the input identity, simplified soft surface brushwork, no individual realistic fur strands, no photorealistic/cinematic 3D rendering. Plain very light gray background, neutral even illumination, faint contact shadow. Whole ears and feet inside frame, consistent symmetric anatomy. No flowers/crown/bouquet/props/butterflies or external decorations, no text/watermark, no markings added. Blossom details INSIDE eyes are anatomy identity and must remain. Do not shrink head, lengthen limbs, slim body or enlarge mouth. Output only the single character image.

items.label: 顔アップ・ニュートラル

Create one front face close-up of EXACTLY the same Shushu in image 2, same open dark plum oval eyes, precise pink blossom motifs inside eyes, white catchlights and peach lower-eye reflection, curved dark upper eye rims, pink patches, softly blushing rounded cheeks, tiny brown nose and SMALL CLOSED two-lobed smile attached to nose. Preserve the face proportions and relative spacing. Frame the complete head including both complete pink ears and rounded cheeks, just a small amount of shoulders below, centered straight-on and level. Same clean soft stylized illustration treatment as source images, simplified soft surface strokes; no photorealistic fur, no cinematic/3D reinterpretation. Plain very light gray background, neutral even light. Remove all external flowers/crown/bouquet/butterflies/props while preserving blossoms INSIDE eyes. No text, no watermark. Change only framing to close-up: never redesign eyes or mouth, no larger smile, no open mouth/tongue, no new markings.
